strategy.summary: The project focuses on developing a comprehensive Platform as a Service (PaaS) called wE, which aims to empower users to control, protect, and monetize their personal data. Key strategies include utilizing advanced biometric security methods, enhancing user interaction through a dedicated app, and implementing a reminder queue system. The project also plans to introduce new messaging protocols and a skill store as part of its stretched goals.
